responsibility: This implementation module realizes the Logitech-compatible fixed-buffer string library by combining StrLib primitives with DynamicStrings helpers. It performs copying, concatenation, length and comparison directly through StrLib, while using DynamicStrings to implement substring insertion, deletion, search, and slice-based copying before copying results back into caller-provided character arrays.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Strings pair: it executes the operations declared in Strings.def, delegating simple primitives to StrLib and using DynamicStrings for insertion, deletion, search, and slicing.
